GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES INSURANCE COMPANY
SKILLED ARTISANS AND TECHNICIANS GROUP INSURANCE PLAN –
CALIFORNIA
1
EFFECTIVE 07/16/2018
*Rating Rules
For those risks meeting the group eligibility outlined below, premiums will be reduced by the following
percentages:
Bodily Injury
6%
Property Damage
6%
Collision
11%
Comprehensive
22%
Uninsured Motorists – BI
12%
Uninsured Motorists – PD
12%
Medical Payments
12%
Rental Reimbursement
2%
Emergency Road Service
2%
MBI
7%
This reduction will not apply if the named insured/applicant or spouse or registered domestic partner of the
named insured is already receiving a lower rate under another Group Insurance Plan. This reduction will
not apply to motor homes or travel trailers covered under Miscellaneous Rule 6.
Group Eligibility
The named insured/applicant or spouse or registered domestic partner of the named insured must be an
operator and a graduate student, employed in one of the following occupations, or retired from one of the
following occupations and no longer employed.
